decision_summary: v0.6.34 retrospective: same-evidence replay exposes policy brittleness without pretending to choose policy.
rationale: The narrow extension reused consequence records and made action flips auditable. Straddling the baseline prevents one-sided reassurance. Remaining limitation: binary proceed/defer cannot express human or specialist escalation routes.
recommendation: Add governed selective escalation in v0.6.35 without treating deferral counts as quality.
